result.title: Delivering more meals to more moms with ChatGPT
result.description:
Mandela started Welcome Home to deliver meals to new moms, not to spend 90 minutes every week updating labels.
So we helped her get the best out of ChatGPT, by turning her weekly menu spreadsheet into ready-to-print labels in just 6 minutes.

Your turn: what do you wish existed? Drop your idea below or send us a DM. Maybe we’ll come build it with you next. More at getwelcomehome.co

result.title: How to Build a Personalized Meal Planner with ChatGPT Work
result.description: Follow a working mom as she turns a simple note about her daughter’s food preferences and allergies into a personalized weekly meal planner. See how she creates a shareable site, prepares an Instacart cart for approval, captures meal feedback from her phone, and sets up a weekly task to start the next plan.
